Sunday roast chicken with lemon and thyme

text: Every family has a banana bread recipe, and this one is ours. My grandmother scribbled it on the back of an envelope in 1987, and the envelope still lives in the kitchen drawer, butter stains and all. The secret is using bananas that are almost black. Mash three of them with melted butter, then stir in light brown sugar, an egg, vanilla extract, plain flour, bicarbonate of soda and a pinch of salt. Some people add walnuts; we never do.

text:
Weeknight lentil dal

Serves 4 (the recipe doubles easily for 8 if you're feeding a crowd)
Prep: 10 minutes | Cook: 30 minutes
Vegetarian and naturally gluten-free.

Rinse red lentils and simmer them with vegetable stock, turmeric and a little salt until soft. Meanwhile, fry onion, garlic, ginger and cumin seeds in ghee, then stir the mixture through the lentils and finish with a squeeze of lime.

text: Quick chickpea and spinach curry. It's vegan, so it's vegetarian-friendly too. I make this when the fridge is nearly empty: fry an onion with garlic and curry paste, add a tin of chickpeas, a tin of coconut milk and a few handfuls of spinach, then simmer until thick. Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and eat it straight away.

text:
Classic French omelette (serves 1)

Prep: 5 minutes. Cook: 3 minutes.

Beat two eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt a knob of butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat, pour in the eggs and stir quickly with a fork until just set, then roll the omelette onto a warm plate. Optional garnish: chopped chives. The whole thing takes less than ten minutes, so make it to order.

text:
Slow-cooked beef ragù

Serves 6. Prep 20 minutes, cook 3 hours.

Brown beef chuck in olive oil, then soften onion, carrot and celery in the same pot. Add garlic, tomato purée, red wine, chopped tomatoes, beef stock and two bay leaves, and simmer gently until the beef falls apart. Serve over pappardelle with grated Parmesan.
notes: 3 hours is 180 minutes

text:
Sheet-pan halloumi and vegetables

Total time: 50 minutes (15 minutes prep, 35 minutes in the oven). Serves 3.

A vegetarian traybake: toss courgette, red onion, cherry tomatoes and peppers with olive oil and dried oregano, roast for 20 minutes, then add sliced halloumi and roast for the final 15. Drizzle with honey before serving.

text: Roasted carrot and ginger soup is what I make the minute the weather turns cold. You roast the carrots with an onion and a splash of olive oil, then blend everything with fresh ginger, vegetable stock and a spoonful of crème fraîche. Season with salt and pepper and it's done. It freezes beautifully, so I always make a big batch.
